what_i_did: Copied build.py, make_views.py, hero_check.py and run.sh from models/sunflower and reshaped them to the charming hero; same object layout (soil, stem, leaves, petals_back/mid/front, seed_disc), same material names and roles, same origin, front -Y, top at 1.585 m. Plant group, so no variants.

No turnaround for this job, so it is scored on the hero alone. make_views.py keys mj/sunflower-charming/hero.png per row against the backdrop and drops the warm cast shadow that runs off to the left (below 80 % of the height only low-blue olive pixels in a band round the stalk are kept), then cuts below the stalk foot.
hero_check.py kept the normal model's calibrated direction (front-on, 5 deg up, harness lens); the charming hero is drawn just as level.

Chubbier than the normal one (radius 3.6 cm at the base to 2.7 cm under the head, plus a flared foot), nearly straight with a soft bow taken from the hero, standing on a small domed dirt mound (Soil_Dirt) about 20 x 16 cm.

Four big plump ovals (the hero has four, not the normal six): upper left, upper right on a long petiole, big low left and big low right. Rounder outline with a soft heart base, a cushion bulge on each half and a shallow midrib fold; 18 triangles each, double-sided, faces turned to the viewer and up.

Oversized: about 0.70 m across (44 % of the height, the normal is a third), turned 7 deg to the side and 4 deg down for a bit of lean. Three rings (18 Petal_Amber behind, 18 + 16 Petal_Gold in front) of fat, blunt, rounded petals (10 triangles: a two-step raised midrib), the front rings cupped forward and the bottom petals hanging a little longer, as in the hero. The seed centre is the hero's toy doughnut: a fat Petal_Amber rim (new object disc_rim, existing material) round a sunken Seed_Brown hollow, recoloured burnt orange to match.

901 triangles (budget 1k), 8 meshes, one flat material each, the same six materials as the normal sunflower. 0.70 x 0.21 x 1.585 m, origin at the base on the ground, base clamped to z = 0. No animation.
good: Hero silhouette IoU 0.794 (768 px, 48 samples) from the hero's own direction: head size and placement, the four leaves and the stalk line up.
Reads as the same sunflower but toy-like: a huge buttery head with a fat orange doughnut centre on a chubby stalk with four big cushion leaves.
Drops in for the normal one: same parts, materials and roles, same height, within budget at 901 triangles.
off: The hero's petals are soft, rounded, almost clay-like; mine are 10-triangle faceted cards with a raised midrib, blunter and plumper than the normal ones but still faceted.
The outer amber petals poke out a little more sharply than the hero's soft outer ring.
The hero shows no soil; I kept a small dirt mound so the parts and materials match the normal model and the plant sits on the ground.
Footprint: 0.70 x 0.21 m against the normal 0.58 x 0.23 m. The charming head and leaves are wider, as the hero draws them; it is still a flat, face-forward plant.
Seed_Brown still matches none of the game's role words (role 'plain'), as in the normal model.

rounds.change: First build from hero measurements: bigger head with doughnut rim and hollow, three rings of blunt plump petals, four oval leaves, chubbier stalk.
Leaves up 4-5 cm and faced a little less upward, wider petals, base clamped to z = 0.
Longer upper-left and low-right leaves, upper-right leaf angled down, low-left leaf lower, head left and back petals longer.
Upper-left leaf up, low-left leaf lower and more sloped, head a touch left and up.
Cupped the front and mid petal rings forward with higher midribs for a plumper toy head (IoU flat, reads rounder); final 768 px / 48 sample render.

moving_parts: None. The game poses and sways plants itself.
creative_additions: A fat toy doughnut rim round the seed hollow and cupped front petals so the head reads puffy, and a flared chubby foot on the stalk.
